meta.name: Marvel - Daredevil
meta.description: La serie está protagonizada por Charlie Cox como Matt Murdock, un abogado del barrio neoyorquino de Hell's Kitchenque quedó ciego en un accidente que incrementó sus cuatro sentidos restantes y que lucha todas las noches contra el crimen bajo el sobrenombre de Daredevil.

videos.title: Into the Ring
videos.overview: Murdock's vigilante crime fighting and his new law practice find equally dangerous challenges in a murder case tied to a corporate crime syndicate.

videos.title: Cut Man
videos.overview: Murdock makes a near fatal error while trying to save a kidnapped boy, and finds an unlikely ally when he needs saving himself.

videos.title: Rabbit in a Snowstorm
videos.overview: Murdock and Foggy take on a mysterious wealthy client, but Murdock is convinced that there's more to the case than just the facts.

videos.title: In the Blood
videos.overview: Two vicious Russian brothers working for Fisk strike back against Daredevil. Fisk moves to further consolidate his power in the criminal underworld.

videos.title: World on Fire
videos.overview: Fisk moves forward with plans that threaten to rip Hell's Kitchen apart. Murdock and Foggy take on a case helping tenants victimized by a slumlord.

videos.title: Condemned
videos.overview: Daredevil finds himself trapped in the fallout of Fisk's plan to take control of Hell's Kitchen. Ben Urich digs closer to the truth.

videos.title: Stick
videos.overview: An important figure from Murdock's past reemerges seeking his help to battle a new enemy threatening Hell's Kitchen.

videos.title: Shadows in the Glass
videos.overview: While Murdock, Foggy and Karen's mission becomes clearer, Fisk's world spins further out of control in his battle for Hell's Kitchen.

videos.title: Speak of the Devil
videos.overview: When Fisk gains the upper hand, the goal to destroy him becomes even more difficult, while Daredevil faces his own demons.

videos.title: Nelson v. Murdock
videos.overview: Murdock and Foggy's relationship is put to the ultimate test while a new enemy against Fisk emerges.

videos.title: The Path of the Righteous
videos.overview: Fisk and Murdock wrestle with the consequences of their chosen paths, while Ben and Karen get closer to Fisk's true past.

videos.title: The Ones We Leave Behind
videos.overview: Fisk seeks revenge while Karen is haunted by recent events. Daredevil makes a startling discovery about Fisk's financing.

videos.title: Daredevil
videos.overview: In the season finale, a boxed-in Fisk and a desperate Murdock, Foggy and Karen are forced to play their end games.

videos.title: Bang
videos.overview: Hell's Kitchen has calmed, but it's not out of the fire yet. When an unknown vigilante begins to take the fight to the streets in a big and bloody way, Matt Murdock must don the mask of Daredevil to stop him before innocent people end up in the crossfire.

videos.title: Dogs to a Gunfight
videos.overview: As Murdock recovers from an attack, Foggy and Karen fight to protect their new client from both the law and the Kitchen's newest vigilante.

videos.title: New York's Finest
videos.overview: Trapped face-to-face with the Punisher, Daredevil wrestles with the morality of vigilante justice. Meanwhile, Foggy and Karen work to save the firm.

videos.title: Penny and Dime
videos.overview: Karen uncovers shocking facts about the Punisher, who finds himself hunted by a powerful force in Hell's Kitchen. Daredevil ponders his next moves.

videos.title: Kinbaku
videos.overview: A former lover arrives in Hell's Kitchen and turns Murdock's world upside down. Karen digs for the truth about the Punisher.

videos.title: Regrets Only
videos.overview: A lethal foe returns with a vengeance, Foggy and Murdock risk the firm to ensure justice, and Karen sees a different side of the Punisher.

videos.title: Semper Fidelis
videos.overview: Murdock and Foggy take on the DA in the trial of the century, but their client refuses to play along. Murdock struggles to balance his dual identities.

videos.title: Guilty as Sin
videos.overview: As the firm's trial spins out of control, a figure from Murdock's past returns to deliver shocking revelations about the future of Hell's Kitchen.

videos.title: Seven Minutes in Heaven
videos.overview: Castle gets an offer he can't refuse. Foggy and Murdock question the future of their firm, but Karen won't give up so easily.

videos.title: The Man in the Box
videos.overview: Murdock and Foggy get caught in the crossfire of the Punisher's revenge. Karen and Murdock dig for the truth in very different ways.
The Punisher's war continues, and so does the body count in Hell's Kitchen. Murdock tries to finish what the DA started.

videos.title: The Dark at the End of the Tunnel
videos.overview: Daredevil goes underground to save an old friend. Karen follows a dangerous lead. The law firm of Nelson and Murdock may have reached its final chapter.

videos.title: A Cold Day in Hell's Kitchen
videos.overview: In the season finale, Daredevil is backed into the ultimate showdown for his own life - and the future of Hell's Kitchen.

videos.title: Resurrection
videos.overview: Shattered physically and spiritually, Matt rethinks his purpose and place in Hell's Kitchen. Meanwhile, Fisk puts a plan in motion from behind bars.

videos.title: Please
videos.overview: Grieving for the life he's abandoned, Matt suffers a crisis of faith. Fisk makes a deal with the FBI that turns him into a target.

videos.title: No Good Deed
videos.overview: As Fisk moves into swanky new digs amid a public outcry, Matt wrestles with how far he's ready to go to right this wrong. Dex's aim comes into focus.

videos.title: Blindsided
videos.overview: While Matt infiltrates a prison to find information on the Albanians, Fisk puts Dex in his crosshairs and a fed-up Foggy goes on the offensive.

videos.title: The Perfect Game
videos.overview: To quell the rising backlash over his release, Fisk serves up a scapegoat to the FBI. Dex misses the mark when he runs into a woman from his past.

videos.title: The Devil You Know
videos.overview: Driven to the edge, Dex loses his way until he's offered a lifeline by Fisk. Matt comes to Karen for help, which she agrees to give -- on one condition.

videos.title: Aftermath
videos.overview: The press crucifies Daredevil after the attack on the Bulletin, and Agent Nadeem suspects the FBI paid too high a price for Fisk's cooperation.

videos.title: Upstairs/Downstairs
videos.overview: A desperate Dex reaches out for help, Matt forms an uneasy alliance with Agent Nadeem, and Karen concocts a dangerous plan to provoke Fisk.

videos.title: Revelations
videos.overview: Matt's already shaky world tilts when he learns a shocking truth. Karen runs for her life. Nadeem discovers how deep Fisk's influence runs.

videos.title: Karen
videos.overview: Hunted by Fisk and haunted by mistakes from her past, Karen seeks refuge at the church. Matt finally gets his shot, and Dex goes in for the kill.

videos.title: Reunion
videos.overview: Dex tries to run his prey to ground, Nadeem's conscience kicks in, and Fisk looks to recover a gift from Vanessa seized during his incarceration.

videos.title: One Last Shot
videos.overview: Fisk’s long-awaited reunion doesn't go as planned. Nelson & Murdock take on a new client who holds key information on Kingpin.

videos.title: A New Napkin
videos.overview: In the season finale, Matt prepares to cross the line, as Dex becomes more dangerous than ever and Fisk enacts his endgame.
